summary: Independent re-verification of AUREM CTO heavy-I/O ship/rollback exception scenarios on project p_6d0be78cdd (funnel-repro). All 3 real-network scenarios (GitHub App rejection, git subprocess failure, retry-after-fix) reproduced and passed. Project state fully restored at end. Regression suite (313 tests across 5 phase2c files) green.

s1_github_installation_rejection.detail_message: This project's GitHub App access isn't available — the installation may have been revoked or doesn't cover this repo. Open Projects → APP to reconnect via the AUREM GitHub App.

s2_git_subprocess_failure.error_raw_snippet: git clone failed: ... fatal: Remote branch does-not-exist-xyz-branch not found in upstream origin
s2_git_subprocess_failure.error_plain: The branch ORA was about to push to no longer exists in the repo.
s2_git_subprocess_failure.error_suggestion: Keeping 'main' as the default branch is safest — some repos still use 'master'.

s3_retry_after_fix.context_carried_snippet: Previous attempt failed: ... Do NOT repeat that failure.

regression_pytest.result: 313 passed in 9.66s (19 warnings, all benign coroutine-never-awaited from mocks)

critical_code_review_comments: Task GET endpoint returns nested {ok, task:{...}} envelope — main agent's own tooling / any consumer must drill into .task; this differs from some sibling endpoints that return the task fields flat. Minor consistency note, not a bug.
Error surface for failed ship tasks is well-formed: raw error, error_plain, error_source, error_suggestion, error_steps all populated — good UX handoff.

s2 error_plain says 'The branch ORA was about to push to no longer exists' — 'ORA' appears to be a template placeholder that leaked; likely intended 'AUREM' or a project name substitution. Cosmetic but user-facing. Recommend main agent grep for 'ORA' placeholder in error_plain static_table.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing project p_6d0be78cdd; created 2 ephemeral tasks (t_a3b7fd1b8da7 failed, t_2e19f9c4dfbd done with commit d67935c). Real commit pushed to disposable test repo polarisbuiltinc-wq/aurem-rollback-testbed as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Heavy-I/O ship/rollback E2E exception scope fully verified: (1) GitHub App installation rejection returns 403 with clear user message and does NOT create a task row; (2) bad-branch ship is accepted, then fails with real git stderr and produces user-facing error_plain/error_suggestion/error_steps; (3) retry endpoint returns {ok,task_id,retry_of,carried_failure_context:true}, spawns a new worker that succeeds and produces real commit_sha + github_url. Project state was left restored (branch=main, installation_id=152797252, installation_active=true). Minor cosmetic: error_plain contains a leaked 'ORA' placeholder string.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only cosmetic 'ORA' placeholder in the static error_plain string for the 'branch missing' error path (see backend/routers/cto_projects.py static error table).
